taxonomy.notes: Approved the proposed high-impact taxonomy for regulatory_status, clinical_or_safety, manufacturing_or_quality, entity_identity, and review_completeness.

thresholds.decision_note: Approved the WP1 reviewer draft and retained the PI-1972 quality-first starting thresholds; efficiency changes must not weaken blocking evidence, completeness, isolation, or execution-control gates.
